text: In Odoo, create a new quotation in the Sales app: go to Sales > Orders > Quotations, click New. In the Customer field (an autocomplete dropdown), type 'fwod85-n1 Bench Customer' and select the matching option from the dropdown that appears (the value only counts if an option is actually chosen from the dropdown, not merely typed). Then in the Order Lines table add exactly ONE order line: click into the product cell, type a product name or open the product dropdown, and pick any real product from the catalogue (choose one that exists, e.g. a standard product like 'Desk Combination' or whatever appears in the dropdown), set Quantity to 3. Let Odoo auto-fill the Unit Price and taxes. Do NOT add a second line. Save the quotation. Then report: (a) the exact product name you chose, (b) the Unit Price the app filled in for that line, (c) the Untaxed Amount the app computes and displays in the totals section, and (d) the quotation reference/name shown at the top of the form. Do not wait for network idle - the app long-polls; wait for concrete page state.
